FUNCTION TO FIND THE LONGEST PALINDROMIC SUBSTRING:

FUNCTION LONGESTPALINDROME(S):
    IF S IS EMPTY:
        RETURN ""
    N = LENGTH(S)
    START = 0
    END = 0
    FOR I IN 0 TO N-1:
        LEN1 = EXPANDAROUND(S, I, I)
        LEN2 = EXPANDAROUND(S, I, I+1)
        MAXLEN = MAX(LEN1, LEN2)
        IF MAXLEN > END - START:
            START = I - (MAXLEN - 1) // 2
            END = I + (MAXLEN // 2)
    RETURN SUBSTRING(S, START, END + 1)

FUNCTION EXPANDAROUND(S, LEFT, RIGHT):
    WHILE LEFT >= 0 AND RIGHT < LENGTH(S) AND S[LEFT] == S[RIGHT]:
        LEFT = LEFT - 1
        RIGHT = RIGHT + 1
    RETURN RIGHT - LEFT - 1

ALGORITHM EXPLANATION:

THE ALGORITHM USES A CENTER-EXPANSION APPROACH. FOR EACH CHARACTER IN THE STRING, IT TREATS IT AS A CENTER FOR POTENTIAL ODD-LENGTH PALINDROMES AND AS A CENTER BETWEEN TWO CHARACTERS FOR EVEN-LENGTH PALINDROMES. IT EXPANDS OUTWARDS WHILE THE CHARACTERS ARE EQUAL, CALCULATING THE LENGTH OF THE PALINDROME FOUND. THE MAXIMUM LENGTH FOUND DURING THE ITERATION DETERMINES THE LONGEST PALINDROMIC SUBSTRING.

TIME COMPLEXITY:

THE TIME COMPLEXITY OF THIS ALGORITHM IS O(N^2), WHERE N IS THE LENGTH OF THE INPUT STRING. THIS IS BECAUSE FOR EACH OF THE N CHARACTERS, WE MAY EXPAND UP TO N/2 TIMES IN THE WORST CASE. THE SPACE COMPLEXITY IS O(1) AS WE USE ONLY A CONSTANT AMOUNT OF ADDITIONAL SPACE.
